div.p: Academic context, a European community and technical collaboration come together around open learning.

article.p: UAlg provides the academic context in which FACODI developed. Official curricular references, including LESTI, help organise learning paths and curricular units.
FACODI complements the university's teaching and official systems; content mappings do not award ECTS or academic equivalence.
The European University of the Seas connects universities and their communities. FACODI participates in the SEA-EU student-led project ecosystem.
The project was presented at the Being SEA-EU Conference in Gdańsk in September 2026, opening conversations about accessible, community learning.
Corvanis connects professional software practice and the project's technical development through Marcelo's work with Odoo and digital platforms.
This collaboration brings practical experience to the construction of a maintainable, open digital campus.

div.p: Bring an educational resource, a community initiative or an idea for collaboration. Tell us how we can work together.
